references.text: Psalm 41:1 mentions care for the weak, which can be related to Jesus' visit to Simon the leper.
Luke 7:36-50 describes a similar event where Jesus is in a Pharisee's house and a woman anoints his feet.
Mark 14:3-9 also tells of an anointing of Jesus in Bethany, but with some variations in detail.
John 12:1-8 gives another account of an anointing of Jesus in Bethany, focusing on Mary, Martha, and Lazarus.
